name: @mls/directline-token
description: Direct Line token endpoint (L8): exchanges the Copilot Studio Direct Line secret for a short-lived, conversation-scoped token so the control tower's Ask tab never holds a credential. Azure Functions, Node v4 programming model.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT a member of the repo-root `workspaces` list, for the same reason apps/vuln-lab is not: it deploys as its own Azure Functions app with its own dependency closure, and hoisting @azure/functions into the root tree would put a server SDK in the dependency graph of the browser apps. Install and test it from this directory.
